Name: Beautiful Buffalo
Author: nugmods
Description:
My original sprites for Mizu's Buffalo! While these are my own work, they are inspired heavily by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2933]Kwillow's Cows[/url] and intended to be paired with K's work. Covers the white and black buffalos and their babies.

Fun fact! Mizu's Buffalo is neither a Bison nor an African Buffalo, but rather, an Asian Water Buffalo! They were domesticated in the Indian Subcontinent thousands of years ago and now different breeds are found in herds all across Europe and Asia, from the Philippines to Romania. I wanted my take to be distinct from the typical dairy cow, hence their big, floppy ears and curled horns, which were inspired by the Murrah, an Indian breed of water buffalo prized for its milk production.

[b]Install:[/b]
Just put it in your mods folder, I promise it's that easy
